hypothesis.primary_statement: The absolute Bybit perpetual-vs-official-index basis contracts more strongly during the mechanism-defined T-30m to T-5m window than during the equal-length immediately preceding control window T-55m to T-30m.
hypothesis.direction_rule_for_future_execution: At T-30m, future execution direction is fixed causally as SHORT perpetual if basis>0, LONG perpetual if basis<0, and NO_DIRECTION if basis=0. This rule is frozen before outcome access.

causal_observability.notice_source: Frozen Bybit announcement API source census

affected_contract.authority: Bybit official public V5 Market API
affected_contract.purpose: Affected perpetual price snapshot plus nonzero-activity integrity check.

official_index.authority: Bybit official public V5 Market API

data_sources.source_substitution_rule: No alternate venue, third-party archive, mark price, premium index, spot proxy or reconstructed index may replace a missing primary source without a new pre-registration before any such substitute values are read.

sampling.candle_rule: For target time t, use only the exact fully closed 1-minute candle with startTime=t-60000 ms and therefore ending at t. No nearest-neighbor substitution, interpolation, forward fill, backward fill or later candle is allowed.
sampling.contract_and_index_alignment: Exact same candle startTime required for contract and index.
sampling.final_5_minutes: Excluded from the primary P0 sentinel to avoid confounding by terminal trading-stop/cancel mechanics. No alternate last-minute horizon may be selected after outcomes.

required: event is one of the exact frozen 94
all six registered candles exist: contract+index at -55m,-30m,-5m
all exact startTime identities match the registered minute
contract volume>0 and turnover>0 for all three registered contract candles
all numeric fields are finite and positive
forbidden_filters: no filter based on observed return
no filter based on basis magnitude
event_eligibility.missing_data_handling: Ineligible events are retained in the audit ledger as SOURCE_MISSING/INVALID and are never silently dropped.

inference.cluster_metric: median of constituent eligible event metric
inference.cross_cluster_weighting: equal weight per delivery timestamp cluster
inference.monthly_breadth: calendar month of T; report cluster-median D by each frozen month 2026-01 through 2026-09
inference.uncertainty: nonparametric bootstrap resampling delivery clusters with replacement
inference.event_level_statistics_role: descriptive only; not IID inferential units

fee_and_headroom_precommitment.purpose: Screen whether the mechanism has enough gross basis-convergence scale to justify a later L1 execution study; this is not PnL.
fee_and_headroom_precommitment.official_reference_note: Bybit official fee documentation lists VIP0 standard perpetual/futures taker fee 0.055% (5.5 bps) per side and higher special-zone taker fees can reach 0.11% (11 bps) per side; actual rates may vary by region/VIP.
fee_and_headroom_precommitment.rule: The 30 bps threshold is a conservative research-screen hurdle, not an assumed realized cost and not a profitability claim.

official_references.title: Bybit Trading Fee Structure
official_references.relevant_facts: VIP0 standard perpetual/futures taker 0.055% per side; special perpetual zones may have higher taker rates; actual rates may vary by region/VIP.

official_references.title: Bybit Futures Contracts: Fees Explained
official_references.relevant_facts: USDT perpetual/futures standard taker example 0.055% per side; delisting/settlement fee treatment may differ from ordinary trading and is not assumed in P0.

pass_if: at least one eligible delivery cluster in each frozen delivery month
90% bootstrap lower bound for cluster-level median D > 0
fraction of eligible delivery clusters with D>0 >= 0.60
monthly median D > 0 in at least 6 of 9 frozen months

ordered_rule: If cluster-level median C_event <= 11 bps: REJECT_STRUCTURAL_ECONOMIC_SCALE.
If 11 bps < cluster-level median C_event < 30 bps: DEFER_COST_HEADROOM; do not build a complex L1 simulator yet.
If cluster-level median C_event >= 30 bps and timing_specificity_gate passes: PASS_TO_P1_EXECUTION_FEASIBILITY.

contamination_and_stop_rules.if_reject: Terminal for this P0 basis-convergence architecture on the frozen 94-event evidence. Reusable findings may be extracted, but no rescue-tuning on the same outcomes.
contamination_and_stop_rules.if_pass: Design a separate P1 execution-feasibility specification using L1/trade data and actual cost/latency assumptions before any PnL claim.
contamination_and_stop_rules.if_defer: Resolve source/cost feasibility without selecting events or horizons by observed outcomes.

p1_boundary_if_p0_passes.intended_primary_hold: T-30m decision to T-5m exit decision, approximately 25 minutes
p1_boundary_if_p0_passes.intended_side_rule: convergence side fixed by sign of B(T-30m)
required_before_p1: historical executable L1 or equivalent defensible execution source
account/region fee-rate assumption frozen independently of P0 outcomes
